extraMeanings.en: to say or do something offensive to someone
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He insulted her by calling her lazy in front of everyone.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Herkesin önünde ona tembel diyerek onu aşağıladı.

extraMeanings.en: an opening through which air or liquid enters a machine or engine
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The engine's air intake was blocked by leaves.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Motorun hava girişi yapraklarla tıkanmıştı.

extraMeanings.en: the intention to do something (noun)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She was charged with wounding with intent to kill.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öldürme kastıyla yaralamaktan suçlandı.

extraMeanings.en: to exchange things, or to put one thing in the place of another
extraMeanings.exampleEn: You can interchange the two batteries without any problem.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İki pili sorunsuzca birbirinin yerine kullanabilirsin.

extraMeanings.en: to perform a piece of music or a role in your own way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The pianist interpreted the sonata with great emotion.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Piyanist sonatı büyük bir duyguyla yorumladı.

extraMeanings.en: to suggest or make something known indirectly (verb)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He intimated that he might resign if things did not change.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İşler değişmezse istifa edebileceğini ima etti.

extraMeanings.en: a person who is ill or disabled and needs care (noun, stress on first syllable)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: After the accident she was left an invalid for the rest of her life.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kazadan sonra hayatının geri kalanında hasta/sakat kaldı.

extraMeanings.tr: ciddi ve derin duygularla, tutkulu biçimde
extraMeanings.en: in a very serious and deeply emotional way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He looked at her intensely, as if trying to read her thoughts.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sanki düşüncelerini okumaya çalışırcasına ona tutkuyla/derin bir yoğunlukla baktı.

extraMeanings.en: an injection or vaccination (British informal)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I got my flu jab at the clinic yesterday.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dün klinikte grip aşımı oldum.

extraMeanings.en: a stupid or unpleasant person (informal noun)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He was such a jerk to leave without paying his share.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Payını ödemeden gitmesiyle tam bir pislikti.

extraMeanings.en: very good, quick, or well developed (of senses or mind)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Köpeklerin keskin bir koku alma duyusu vardır.

extraMeanings.en: a goalkeeper in football (informal)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The keeper made a brilliant save in the last minute.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kaleci son dakikada muhteşem bir kurtarış yaptı.

extraMeanings.en: to attach a label to, or to describe someone in a particular way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The media unfairly labelled him a troublemaker.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Medya haksız yere onu bela çıkaran biri olarak damgaladı.

extraMeanings.en: a company that produces and sells recorded music
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The band signed with a major record label.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Grup büyük bir plak şirketiyle anlaşma imzaladı.

extraMeanings.en: a delay between two events (noun)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There is often a time lag between infection and symptoms.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Enfeksiyon ile belirtiler arasında genellikle bir zaman gecikmesi vardır.

extraMeanings.tr: yetersiz, ikna edici olmayan, zayıf (bahane vb.)
extraMeanings.en: weak and unconvincing (of an excuse, argument or joke)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He gave a lame excuse for being late again.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yine geç kalması için zayıf/inandırıcı olmayan bir bahane uydurdu.

extraMeanings.en: one complete circuit of a racetrack
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He overtook two cars on the final lap.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Son turda iki arabayı geçti.

extraMeanings.en: something done for fun or amusement (informal)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We climbed the wall just for a lark.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Duvara sırf eğlence olsun diye tırmandık.

extraMeanings.en: to hit hard, or to beat against something violently (verb)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The waves lashed against the rocks during the storm.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Fırtına sırasında dalgalar kayalara şiddetle çarptı.

extraMeanings.en: to fasten or close something with a latch (verb)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She latched the gate behind her.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Arkasından kapıyı mandalla kapattı.

extraMeanings.en: to let liquid or gas escape, or to give secret information to the public (verb)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Someone leaked the report to the press before it was official.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Biri rapor resmi olmadan önce onu basına sızdırdı.

extraMeanings.en: to jump high or a long distance (verb)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The cat leaped onto the table.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kedi masanın üstüne sıçradı.

extraMeanings.en: to rent property or equipment under a lease (verb)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They leased the office space for five years.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ofis alanını beş yıllığına kiraladılar.

extraMeanings.en: to run slowly and steadily for exercise (verb)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She jogs in the park every morning.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Her sabah parkta hafif tempoda koşar.

extraMeanings.en: to make someone remember something (jog someone's memory)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: This old photo might jog your memory.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu eski fotoğraf hafızanı canlandırabilir.

extraMeanings.en: a unit of speed used by ships and aircraft
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The ship was travelling at twenty knots.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gemi yirmi deniz mili/saat hızla ilerliyordu.

extraMeanings.en: at a time after now or after a particular time (adverb)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I will call you later this evening.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sana bu akşam daha sonra telefon ederim.

extraMeanings.en: used to introduce the final point in a list
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Lastly, I would like to thank my family for their support.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Son olarak, desteklerinden dolayı aileme teşekkür etmek isterim.

extraMeanings.en: a narrow horizontal surface sticking out from a wall, especially under a window
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She placed the flowerpot on the window ledge.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Saksıyı pencere denizliğine koydu.
